headline: NovoJuris Legal acts on Dil Foods Series B fundraise
sum: Virtual Restaurant Operator Dil Foods has raised ₹72 crore from a Series B fundraise led by the Bikaji Foods’ family office, with participation from Alteria Capital and existing investors V3…
detail: Virtual Restaurant Operator Dil Foods has raised ₹72 crore from a Series B fundraise led by the Bikaji Foods’ family office, with participation from Alteria Capital and existing investors V3 Ventures, MJV Ventures. NovoJuris Legal advised Dil Foods on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Sharda Balaji (Founding and Managing Partner), Ashwin Bhat (Deputy Managing Partner) and Ritvik Joseph (Senior Associate).
